# Upstream commits

Every upstream non-merge commit, filed under the first registered release that contains it: the commits between the previous registered release and that release. Use this page to find the change behind a behaviour difference that no declared API element shows, then read the commit's diff. Subjects are upstream text; a subject states intent, not verified behaviour.

Commits whose subject ends with `[skip changelog]` (automated formatting and submodule updates) are left out, as the upstream changelog leaves them out. Commits up to the first registered release (`5.0.0`) are not listed. Each commit lists up to 20 changed paths in the source YAML and 5 here.

[← Version index](./index.md) · [Machine changes](./machine-changes.md) · [Symbols](./machine-symbols.md)

Source of truth: `sources/maa-framework/upstream-commits.yaml` (715 commits over 54 releases).
